additional_info.subject: Note -
additional_info.body: The charging station did not accept the credit card and treated the card as an RFID card. In addition, the charging station system also displayed an "internal error" as an error message. At my suggestion, the customer then tried charging station 170003981, where the credit card was accepted on the first attempt, but then there was a long charging time, after which the charging process was immediately terminated. The second attempt then worked.
